Operational Risk, Controls & Governance

raw_sections.experience:
Work Experience
Barclays Global Service Centre Private Limited | Pune | Assistant Vice President | Oct 2018 – May 2026
❖ Directed OTC Derivatives confirmation operations across Credit Derivatives, FX Options, and Money Market products, ensuring timely execution,
control adherence, and service delivery across global counterparties.
❖ Led a strategic industry-wide migration from DTCC to TradeServ, owning UAT execution, business validation, and implementation readiness to
❖
ensure seamless transition with no disruption to BAU operations. Identified and implemented automation opportunities that enhanced Straight-Through Processing (STP), reduced manual touchpoints, and delivered measurable productivity gains across the function.
❖ Managed a team of 4 professionals, driving performance management, workload allocation, knowledge transfer, and capability development within
a high-volume operational environment.
❖ Owned critical Risk & Control reporting & EMIR/CFTC regulatory submissions, maintaining a control framework & achieving zero audit observations. ❖ Partnered with Front Office, Middle Office, Technology, Compliance, and external counterparties to support New Product Approval (NAPA)
initiatives and operational change implementation.
❖ Established KPI and KRI monitoring frameworks, leveraging trend analysis and root cause investigations to reduce operational exceptions and
strengthen process controls.
❖ Acted as key escalation point for complex trade confirmation issues, ensuring timely resolution and mitigation of operational and regulatory risks. ❖ Supported workforce planning activities including capacity assessment, resource allocation, leave management, and workload balancing to ensure
uninterrupted operational coverage.
❖ Participated in hiring, onboarding, and performance evaluation processes, contributing to the development and retention of operational talent. ❖ Coordinated Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and contingency preparedness activities, ensuring operational resilience and adherence to
organizational requirements.
❖ Represented the function in governance forums, control reviews, and stakeholder meetings, providing updates on operational performance, key
risks, and ongoing initiatives.
Nomura Services India Private Limited | Mumbai | Analyst | May 2017 – Oct 2018
❖ Managed end-to-end confirmation processing for OTC derivative transactions across DTCC and ICE platforms, ensuring regulatory compliance and
timely risk mitigation.
❖ Designed and implemented an exception management solution that streamlined daily operations, improved processing efficiency, and
strengthened operational oversight.
❖ Delivered system enhancements within the Phoenix Risk Platform by configuring consent-only and four-way novation trade rules, eliminating
manual intervention and improving processing accuracy.
❖ Played a key role in new entity onboarding and business change initiatives, executing UAT activities and configuring trade routing structures to
support seamless DTCC connectivity.
❖ Collaborated with Front Office and Risk teams on ICE Compression and TriOptima cycles, supporting portfolio optimization and reduction of
counterparty exposure.
❖ Produced management and regulatory reporting including KRI metrics, Fed statistics, and EMIR/CFTC submissions to support governance and
management decision-making.
❖ Supported transition and knowledge transfer activities for new processes and business requirements, ensuring smooth integration into existing
operating procedures.
❖ Contributed to the documentation and maintenance of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process maps, and control documentation to
support operational consistency.
❖ Participated in periodic control testing & process reviews to identify opportunities for strengthening operational effectiveness & compliance standards. ❖ Assisted in training & mentoring new team members, facilitating faster ramp-up & improved understanding of operational workflow and controls.
ECLERX Services Private Limited | Pune | Financial Analyst | Aug 2015 – Apr 2017
❖ Supported OTC confirmation operations for global financial institutions, ensuring trade affirmation and confirmation activities were completed
❖
within FED Target T+1 requirements. Investigated trade discrepancies and confirmation breaks, partnering with clients and counterparties to achieve timely resolution and reduce operational risk.
❖ Analyzed processing failures & workflow bottlenecks, contributing to improvements in Straight-Through Processing rates & overall process efficiency. ❖ Developed client-specific operational reports and MIS dashboards to enhance visibility, exception management, and service delivery.
Trust Systems And Software Private Limited | Nagpur | Implementation Executive | Jan 2012 – Apr 2013
❖
Implemented and supported banking technology solutions for institutional clients, providing deployment support, issue resolution, and post- implementation assistance.
❖ Utilized SQL to investigate and resolve data-related issues, ensuring data integrity and system reliability. ❖ Supported financial reconciliation & reporting activities, including Trial Balance & Balance Sheet validation, to ensure accuracy of financial records.
❖ TradeServ Migration Program | Barclays: Led User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for the industry-wide migration from DTCC to TradeServ, driving
business validation, process readiness, and successful implementation of the new confirmation platform across OTC product workflows.
❖ New Entity Setup & Operational Readiness | Barclays: Played a key role in establishing operational infrastructure for a new legal entity, coordinating with multiple business functions to ensure regulatory compliance, process readiness, and seamless integration into existing operating 
❖ Phoenix Risk System Enhancement | Nomura: Designed and implemented rule-based enhancements within the Phoenix Risk System for consent-
only and four-way novation trades, eliminating manual DTCC processing, strengthening operational controls, and improving processing efficiency.
